summary: Iteration 20 — Critical fix to ghost dash/float animation (Desktop.jsx useEffect dep on `socket` reference was clobbering travel stance with idle ~120ms after each click). Backend regression iter19 suite: 6/6 PASS. Frontend dash/float bug fix: VERIFIED via the new data-stance attribute on [data-testid='iso-avatar']. Far-click → data-stance='dash' for 5 samples (~700ms within 1.6s window). Short-click → data-stance='float' for 6 samples (~720ms within 1.4s window). After 3.5s idle, stance correctly reverts to 'idle' (no spurious overwrite). QuoteBubble TTL extended to 12s — bubble still visible at ~9.8s post-send. New data-* attributes (data-user-id/nickname/stance/anim-id) on iso-avatar make playwright assertions deterministic.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Iter20 fix VERIFIED. The critical fix is in Desktop.jsx L162-169 (lastSentStanceRef + useEffect deps changed from [animStance, socket] to [animStance, socket.connected]). The new data-stance attribute on [data-testid='iso-avatar'] is the canonical way to verify travel stances. Sample at 100-150ms over 1.5-1.7s after a far click and expect >=5 'dash' samples. Backend test_iteration19.py covers the WS regression and bot frequency — runs in ~50s.
rca of the issue: The iter19 'dash inconclusive' issue was caused by Desktop.jsx having a useEffect with [animStance, socket] dependencies. `socket` is the return of useChatSocket() which constructs a new object literal every render. Any state change anywhere in Desktop (users[], messages[], typing[]) would re-render → new socket reference → effect re-fires → socket.send({type:'stance', stance:'idle'}) within ~120ms of any click, clobbering ChatWindow.handleMove's transient stance:'dash'/'float'. Fix: introduced lastSentStanceRef and changed deps to [animStance, socket.connected] (a primitive). Effect now only fires when animStance state actually changes. Verified: dash held for 700+ms, float held for 720+ms, idle revert clean.
